rationales: Messages are not the standard source-code annotations used to explain algorithms.
Hints may guide the reader but are not the standard name for source-code annotations.
Comments explain the techniques and algorithms used in source code.
Explanations is not the usual programming term for these annotations.

This tests whether a is divisible by c, not whether a is a factor of c.
The remainder of c divided by a is zero exactly when a is a factor of c.
This only tests whether either value is zero, not whether a divides c.

A condition may be an arithmetic expression, whose nonzero value is treated as true in C-like languages.
A relational expression can evaluate to true or false and serve as a condition.
A logical expression can evaluate to true or false and serve as a condition.
Conditions can use arithmetic, relational, or logical expressions.
A matrix is a data arrangement, not the standard graphical representation of an algorithm.
A graph is not the standard diagram used to represent an algorithm's steps.
A solution is the result of solving a problem, not a graphical representation.
A flowchart graphically represents the steps and decisions of an algorithm.
Boundary test data checks values at or near the limits of acceptable input.
Valid test data consists of inputs that should be accepted by the program.
Complete test data is not a standard category of test data in this context.
Absent test data can check how a program handles missing input.
By the distributive law of Boolean algebra, (A + B)(A + C) equals A + (B • C).

A hard disk is not primary memory; it stores data persistently as secondary storage.
A hard disk is not RAM, which is volatile main memory.
A hard disk is secondary memory used for long-term data storage.
A hard disk is not ROM, which is read-only memory.
The <td> tag creates a data cell within a table.
The <table> tag defines a table for displaying data in tabular form.
The <tr> tag defines a row within a table.
The <th> tag defines a header cell within a table.
A channel is a communication medium, not the destination network in this definition of routing.
Routing forwards data between devices on different networks.
A path is a route through a network, not the network being referred to here.
An area is not the standard term for a destination in routing.
A hub is not the defining central device in a bus topology.
A hub commonly connects devices in a star topology.
A hub is not the defining connection method in a ring topology.
A hub does not connect every device to every other device as in a mesh topology.
Softlifting is a type of software piracy involving unauthorized copying or sharing.
Liability is not a type of software piracy.
Client-server overuse is a type of software piracy involving excess users on a license.
Online piracy is a type of software piracy involving unauthorized distribution over the internet.
An antivirus program is software, not a person who is a hacker.
A hacker is commonly described as a person with strong computer expertise.
An end user is not necessarily a hacker.
A protocol is a set of communication rules, not a person.
HTML is a valid extension for an HTML page, but it is not the only valid option.
HTM is also a valid extension for an HTML page, but it is not the only valid option.
XHTML is used for XHTML documents, not as the standard alternative intended here.
Both .html and .htm are valid extensions for HTML pages.
The decimal system, based on ten digits, is used in daily life.
The hexadecimal system is base 16 and is not the everyday number system.
The octal system is base 8 and is not the everyday number system.
The binary system is base 2 and is used chiefly in computing.
